query: Find emails from boss@company.example in the last week, then send a reply to one of them with subject "Re: status" and body "On track."
expected_behavior: use `gog gmail search 'from:boss@company.example newer_than:7d' --max <N>` to find the emails
use `gog gmail send --to boss@company.example --subject 'Re: status' --body 'On track.'` to reply
confirm the proposed `gmail send` command with the user before executing (destructive op)
optionally reference `reference/gmail-search.md` for the search operator syntax
notes: Guards the two most-used Gmail flows and the discipline of confirming a send before invoking.
